name: stackra
status: Approved: marks from Brand System 2.0.0; neutral accent accepted by the user 2026-09-29

decided.wordmark: Beam-S (R2 wide arms): stackra in Geist Mono 500, -0.04em, the s drawn as a beam, steel, static; a real s below 24px. S3 Path was superseded 2026-09-26. Brand System, Lockups.
decided.tile: O1 st tile for small sizes: beam-S and t from 32px, a real s at 16px; no stack icon.
decided.colour: Steel (steel on dark, steel-deep on light) is artwork colour only: the wordmark and the tile letters. It never fills a UI role.
decided.accent: No accent colour. The accent-family roles resolve to Figentra's own neutrals (ink and paper) plus a graphite ramp at chroma < 0.02, so no role carries a hue. Accepted by the user 2026-09-29; the Brand System policy line to carry upstream: "A light sub-brand may point the accent family at achromatic neutrals (oklch chroma < 0.02)."
decided.motion: Decided 2026-09-29 (user): keep the Brand System. The wordmark is static; the logo animation fades the frame and only the figentra_ bar in the signature blinks.
decided.endorsement: by figentra_ — the figentra_ bar (cursor) appears in the signature only; the Latin name leads in both locales.
decided.cursor: Inherited unchanged (amber); never used as a cursor on Stackra surfaces, never after the stackra name.
